eventDetail.scope: The scopes of MHS2026 are micro nano mechatronics technology and human science which are currently used in broader spectra, ranging from basic applications in robots, actuators, sensors, semiconductors, automobiles, and machine tools to new applications in bio medicalsystems and life science, construction machines, and aerospace equipment. Applications fields are welfare engineering, human life supporting engineering, medical engineering, and other brand-new scopes.
